## 壹|What it describes

Yi Wood is a neighbor of [fixture A](/en/day-master/zz-fixture-a). Begin at the
[home page](/en), then the [library](/en/library) and the [calculator](/en/bazi-calculator);
the [app](/en/app) turns a chart into chapters, and the [guides](/en/guides) section has
step-by-step help. Method lives on [about](/en/about); data handling on
[privacy](/en/privacy); questions go to [support](/en/support). The
[today](/en/today) strip shows the current pillars.
